dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Thyrotoxic hemichorea due to untreated Graves disease (hyperthyroidism-associated right upper-limb chorea)

ALTERNATIVE: Structural left basal-ganglia lesion causing hemichorea, such as ischemic stroke

ALTERNATIVE: Autoimmune/inflammatory chorea, including systemic lupus erythematosus–associated chorea

ALTERNATIVE: Huntington disease or another hereditary chorea syndrome
